location.en: Corner of Harbor Street and Pine Avenue
location.zh: 港灣街與松樹大道路口

goal.en: Ask a local how to get to Central Station.
goal.zh: 向當地人問路，找到去中央車站的路。

background: quiet street corner in a small harbor town, red brick shops with plain awnings, a zebra crosswalk, an old iron lamppost, a wooden bench under a maple tree, blue sky, late morning

intro.en: After coffee, you want to visit your language school. Central Station is somewhere near here, but your phone battery just died.
intro.zh: 喝完咖啡，你想去語言學校看看。中央車站就在附近某處，偏偏你的手機剛好沒電。

intro.en: An older woman walks by with a small brown dog. She notices you turning in circles.
intro.zh: 一位年長的女士牽著一隻棕色小狗經過。她注意到你在原地轉來轉去。

lines.en: You look a little lost, dear. Can I help you?
lines.zh: 你看起來有點迷路喔。需要幫忙嗎？

choices.en: Yes! How do I get to Central Station?
choices.zh: 要！請問中央車站怎麼去？
choices.tip: How do I get to + 地點？ 是問路最常用的句型。

choices.en: Yes! Central Station, how to go there?

lines.en: How to go...? Oh, you mean the bus station? It's that way.
lines.zh: 怎麼走……？喔，你是說公車總站嗎？在那個方向。

story.en: Mrs. Lee sends you the other way. Twenty minutes later, you are looking at buses, not trains.
story.zh: 李太太把你指向反方向。二十分鐘後，你看著一排公車，而不是火車。

fail.why: 「車站怎麼走」照中文語序說成 Station, how to go? 不是完整的英文問句。問路要說 How do I get to Central Station?

choices.en: No, no, I'm fine! Thank you!

lines.en: Oh... okay then. Good luck, dear!

story.en: She smiles and walks away with her dog. You spend the next hour walking in circles around the same three blocks.
story.zh: 她笑了笑，牽著狗走了。接下來一個小時，你在同樣的三個街區裡繞圈圈。

fail.why: 中文習慣先客氣推辭，但在英語國家 No, I'm fine 會被當真，對方就真的走了。需要幫忙就直接說 Yes!，再問 How do I get to...?

lines.en: Central Station? Easy. Go straight two blocks, then turn left at the bank.
lines.zh: 中央車站？很簡單。直走兩個街區，然後在銀行那裡左轉。

choices.en: So, go straight, then turn left?
choices.tip: 把聽到的方向重複一次，是確認有沒有聽懂的好方法。

choices.en: Too hard. Can you just take me there?
choices.zh: 好難喔。你可以直接帶我去嗎？

lines.en: Take you there? I'm walking my dog, dear.

story.en: Biscuit barks at you, and they walk away. Now you're on your own, and you only remember the word "bank."
story.zh: 比斯吉對你吠了一聲，她們就走了。現在你只能靠自己，而且只記得「銀行」這個字。

fail.why: 對熱心指路的陌生人說「太難了，你帶我去」，要求太多了。把聽到的方向重複一次確認：So, go straight, then turn left?

choices.en: The bank? Is the bank open today?

lines.en: The bank? I think so... but you wanted the station?
lines.zh: 銀行？應該有吧……可是你不是要去車站嗎？

story.en: You walk straight to the bank, check that it's open, and forget the rest of the directions. You end up asking for help again.
story.zh: 你直直走到銀行，確認它有開，然後就忘了接下來怎麼走。最後只好再找人問一次路。

fail.why: 銀行只是轉彎的地標，不是重點。聽完指路後，重複關鍵方向確認：So, go straight, then turn left?

choices.en: Thanks! Is it far from here?
choices.tip: Is it far? 問距離遠不遠，是出發前很實用的一句。

choices.en: Thanks! How long is the station?

lines.en: How long? The building? Oh, it's quite long, I suppose.
lines.zh: 多長？那棟建築嗎？喔，我想應該滿長的吧。

story.en: Mrs. Lee tells you all about the station's long, beautiful roof. Biscuit falls asleep. You still don't know how far it is.
story.zh: 李太太跟你介紹車站又長又美的屋頂。比斯吉都睡著了，你還是不知道車站有多遠。

fail.why: How long is the station? 問的是車站這棟建築有多長。問距離要說 Is it far? 或 How far is it?；問要走多久說 How long does it take?

lines.en: Auntie? Oh my. Have we met before?
lines.zh: 阿姨？天啊。我們以前見過嗎？

story.en: Mrs. Lee tries hard to remember which nephew or niece you are. It takes a long time to explain that in Taiwan, everyone is an auntie.
story.zh: 李太太努力回想你是她哪個姪子或姪女。你花了好久才解釋清楚，在台灣，大家都叫阿姨。

fail.why: 台灣習慣稱呼陌生長輩「阿姨」，但英文的 Auntie 通常只用在真正的親戚身上。道謝說 Thank you so much! 就很有禮貌，再接著問 Is it far?

lines.en: Not far at all. About five minutes on foot. Have a lovely day!
lines.zh: 一點也不遠，走路大約五分鐘。祝你有美好的一天！

lines.en: Biscuit wags her tail as you head off.
lines.zh: 你出發時，比斯吉對你搖了搖尾巴。

story.en: You reach Central Station in exactly five minutes. Asking a real person worked better than any map app.
story.zh: 你剛好走了五分鐘就到中央車站。問真人，比任何地圖 App 都好用。

notes.explain: 問路最常用的句型。不要照中文語序說 Station, how to go?

example.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the library?
example.zh: 不好意思，請問圖書館怎麼去？

notes.en: go straight / turn left / turn right
notes.explain: 指路三大基本詞。at the bank 表示在銀行那裡轉。聽完可以用 So, ...? 重複一次確認。

example.en: Go straight, then turn right at the park.
example.zh: 直走，然後在公園那裡右轉。

notes.explain: 問距離用 Is it far? 或 How far is it?；問花多少時間用 How long does it take?。How long is...? 會變成問東西有多長。

example.en: How long does it take to walk there?

notes.explain: 中文習慣先客氣推辭，但英語國家的人會把 No, I'm fine 當真。真的需要幫忙，就說 Yes, please!

example.en: Do you need help? Yes, please. Thank you!
example.zh: 需要幫忙嗎？要，麻煩你了，謝謝！

notes.explain: 台灣常叫陌生長輩阿姨、叔叔，但英文 Auntie、Uncle 通常只用在親戚或很熟的長輩身上。對陌生人不用特別稱呼。

example.en: Thank you so much! Have a nice day!
example.zh: 真的很謝謝你！祝你有美好的一天！
